routes.name: Visa-free short stay (Schengen)
routes.summary: Citizens of countries on the EU visa-free list can visit Poland for up to 90 days in any 180 days. Poland's foreign ministry publishes the list. Visa-free stays can't be used to work.

other: Passport valid at least 3 months past departure and issued within the last 10 years
Proof of purpose and funds (PLN 75 per day for stays over 4 days)
Official country list not opened here, check the foreign ministry list
Stays on a Polish residence permit or long-stay visa don't count toward the 90 days

sources.label: Your Europe in Poland: residence conditions for foreigners

routes.name: Short-stay Schengen visa (C)
routes.summary: For nationals who need a visa. Allows up to 90 days in any 180 days in Poland and the rest of Schengen. Apply at a Polish consulate through the E-KONSULAT system.

other: Passport valid 3 months past departure, 2 blank pages, issued within 10 years
Travel medical insurance of at least EUR 30,000
Documents vary by consulate

steps: Apply at the consulate of your main destination
Pay the visa fee and submit documents

routes.name: Airport transit visa (A)
routes.summary: Lets you pass through the international transit area of a Polish airport without entering Schengen. Citizens of several countries (for example Afghanistan, Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Nigeria, Pakistan) generally need one.

other: Full list of nationalities not confirmed here, check the EU Commission list the ministry points to

routes.name: National long-stay visa (D)
routes.summary: A Polish national visa for stays of more than 90 days, up to one year. It also allows up to 90 days in 180 in other Schengen states while valid.

other: Health insurance of at least EUR 30,000 for entry
Proof of funds and purpose of stay

sources.label: Your Europe in Poland: residence conditions for foreigners

stay.note: A long-stay visa can be extended only once, up to about one year total.

routes.name: Temporary residence permit (general)
routes.summary: The base permit for staying in Poland over 3 months. Valid up to 3 years, cannot be extended, so you apply for a new one. Apply at the voivodeship office where you live.

other: Different purposes (work, study, business, family) have their own extra documents

stay.note: Up to 3 years. Apply for a new permit instead of extending.

fees.label: Application stamp duty (PLN 340 or PLN 440 depending on basis)

routes.processing: Voivode has 60 days to decide once the file is complete.
steps: Submit in person with 2 photos, passport copies, fee proof and purpose documents

routes.name: Temporary residence and work permit
routes.summary: One permit for living and working for a named employer. Pay can't be below the minimum wage (PLN 4,666 gross per month in 2025). Your employer signs an appendix and must have real activity and funds.

income.note: 2025 minimum wage, gross. Check the current figure.

other: Employer completes Appendix 1
Health insurance, proof of address, tax settlement and no-tax-arrears certificate
If you lose the job, you have 30 days to find a new one

routes.name: EU Blue Card (Poland)
routes.summary: For highly qualified workers with a contract of at least 6 months and a salary of at least 150% of Poland's average gross pay. Valid for the contract plus 3 months, up to 3 years.

eligibility.education: Higher education, or 3 years of experience in the last 7 years, or 5 years of comparable experience
other: Salary at least 150% of the average national salary for the prior year, announced by Statistics Poland
Contract of at least 6 months
Not available if you're on a tourist or family-visit visa

stay.note: Contract length plus 3 months, max 3 years.

routes.name: Temporary residence for seasonal work
routes.summary: For seasonal jobs. Granted for up to 9 months from first entry. Fee is lower than other work permits.

other: Seasonal work permit needed
Stable income, health insurance and accommodation in Poland

routes.name: Temporary residence for business activity
routes.summary: For foreigners running a business in Poland, sitting on the board of their own company, or acting as a proxy. You must show stable income or that the business meets set income or hiring tests.

other: Stable income to cover your and dependents' costs
Company income last year of at least 12 times the average monthly pay, OR 2 full-time employees, OR evidence the business will meet this later
Health insurance, proof of address, tax settlement, no-arrears certificates
Permit length and fee not stated on the page

routes.name: Temporary residence for studies
routes.summary: For full-time university or doctoral studies, or a Polish-language prep course. First permit is 15 months, then up to 3 years at a time for the length of studies.

other: Admission letter from a listed school
Proof of funds for living, study, return trip and housing
Health insurance

stay.note: First permit 15 months, later permits up to 3 years.

routes.name: Residence permit for family of a Polish citizen
routes.summary: For spouses and certain relatives of Polish citizens. Spouses can work without a separate work permit. You need a recent marriage certificate and proof you live together. No income or insurance proof needed.

other: Marriage certificate issued within 3 months
Proof of shared household
Permit refused if the marriage is to dodge the rules
Standard spouse permit length not stated on the page

sources.label: migrant.info.pl: spouse of a Polish citizen

routes.name: Residence permit for family of a foreigner in Poland
routes.summary: For spouses and minor children of non-EU foreigners living in Poland on a permanent, EU long-term, refugee, Blue Card or long-term temporary basis. Sponsor on a temporary permit needs 2 years of residence.

other: Stable regular income for the family
Proof of housing and health insurance
Standard permit length not stated on the page

routes.name: EU, EEA and Swiss citizens: right to live in Poland
routes.summary: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens can stay 3 months with just an ID or passport. After that, register with the voivode if working, self-employed, studying, married to a Pole, or self-supporting with health insurance. Permanent residence after 5 years.

other: Registration is free and has no expiry
Job seekers can stay up to 6 months
Family members are covered too

stay.note: 3 months without registration, then registered stay.

routes.name: Permanent residence permit
routes.summary: Open-ended permit with several routes: spouse of a Pole (3 years married, 2 years on a marriage permit), 4 years on a permit for a desirable profession with stable income, 5 years as refugee or protected person, Polish origin or Pole's Card, and others. Card is renewed every 10 years.

other: Apply in Polish while legally in Poland
Work route: stable income plus 4 years on a work permit in a profession on the official list
Spouse of a Pole: marriage 3+ years, 2 years continuous residence on the marriage permit
Refugee, subsidiary or humanitarian: 5 years
Tolerated stay: 10 years
Can be withdrawn after 6+ years abroad

routes.name: EU long-term resident permit
routes.summary: After 5 years of legal stay in Poland you can get this open-ended permit. You need 3 years of stable income, B1 Polish, health insurance and housing. Card is renewed every 5 years.

eligibility.language: B1 Polish with an official certificate
other: 5 years of continuous legal stay, no break over 6 months, breaks total under 10 months
Stable regular income in the last 3 years (2 for Blue Card holders)
Health insurance and a legal right to your home

routes.name: Polish citizenship (recognition by the voivode)
routes.summary: The main naturalization route. Typical case: 3 years on a permanent or long-term EU permit, stable income, housing and B1 Polish. Shorter for spouses of Poles (2 years plus 3 years married), refugees (2 years) and people of Polish origin (1 year). 10 years of legal residence also works.

other: Standard: 3 years continuous residence on permanent or EU long-term permit, stable income, legal housing
Spouse: 2 years on those permits and 3 years married to a Pole
10 years legal residence plus a permanent or EU long-term permit also qualifies
Dual citizenship rules not stated on the pages opened

sources.label: migrant.info.pl: recognition as a Polish citizen

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship not confirmed from the cited pages.

routes.name: Polish citizenship (granted by the President)
routes.summary: The President can grant citizenship to any foreigner with no fixed conditions or minimum years. You must give a strong reason. The decision needs no explanation and can't be appealed.

other: Apply through the voivode if living in Poland, or through a consul if abroad
Documents need sworn Polish translations
Can take a long time

routes.name: Humanitarian residence and tolerated stay
routes.summary: Border Guard can grant humanitarian residence or tolerated stay when you can't be sent back, for example due to danger, torture risk or family-life rights. This is separate from the asylum procedure, which you should start with the Polish authorities.

other: Granted during return proceedings by the Border Guard
Asylum process details not covered on the page opened
